g.text: Go-live plan, agreed with marketing and support on Sep 22.
Feature-flag the new homepage for internal users first, then 10 % of traffic for one full business day while
we watch conversion, error rate and the p95 of the checkout page against last week.
Lower the DNS TTL to 300 seconds two days before the cut-over so a rollback propagates in minutes, not hours.
Support gets the FAQ and the macro set one week before; the status page draft is written in advance and kept
